title: Infinite Mage
description: Abandoned at birth in a stable, Shirone is raised by a family of commoners. Despite his humble origins, he possesses extraordinary intelligence and teaches himself how to read. After discovering magic and witnessing the hidden workings of the world, Shirone becomes determined to become a mage. In a society where magic is largely reserved for nobles, he must overcome prejudice, dangerous trials, and powerful opponents while discovering the limitless potential of his own abilities.
author: Kimchi Woo
